item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the 2% skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"brief_complete":false,"completion_reason":"A material scope boundary remains unresolved: how much existing operator behavior the streamlined UX must preserve.","questions":[{"decision_key":"ux_compatibility_boundary","label":"UX compatibility","context":"The six-tab architecture is fixed, but the acceptable depth of interaction change is not.","question":"How much existing UX behavior must the streamlined design preserve?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Preserve all current capabilities; simplify their placement and flow."},{"number":2,"text":"Preserve only core workflows; defer secondary capabilities."},{"number":3,"text":"Allow breaking interaction changes while preserving data and service contracts."}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":82}]}
